# Terminal

**PPL language/runtime 4.00 - host object.**

[Object model and calling conventions](../objects.md) | [API index](index.md)

The caller's live terminal and the entry point for capabilities, input, graphics, margins, palette, macros, synchronized output and downloadable fonts.

[Behavior, constraints and examples](../../../new_ppl.md#terminal-information).

Use `Terminal` or `Terminal()` to obtain the current root object.

## BeginUpdate

```PPL
Terminal.BeginUpdate() BOOLEAN
```

Instance function.

Starts or nests a synchronized terminal update. Drawing is buffered by supporting terminals until the matching outermost `EndUpdate`, reducing visible flicker. Returns `FALSE` with `ErrKind.Term`/`ErrCode.Unavailable` when unsupported.
<br><br>**Terminal protocol:** the outermost call sends `CSI ? 2026 h`, bytes `ESC [ ? 2 0 2 6 h`. This is DEC private mode 2026, **Synchronized Output**; support is checked through `Terminal.Info.SynchronizedOutput`.

## EndUpdate

```PPL
Terminal.EndUpdate() BOOLEAN
```

Instance function.

Ends one synchronized-update nesting level. The terminal presents accumulated output when the outermost level ends. Returns `FALSE` with `ErrCode.Invalid` if no update is active.
<br><br>**Terminal protocol:** the outermost end sends `CSI ? 2026 l`, bytes `ESC [ ? 2 0 2 6 l` (DECRST private mode 2026).

## Gfx

`Terminal.Gfx: Gfx`

Read-only instance property.

The caller's graphics session. Initialize it before creating or presenting surfaces and shut it down when drawing is complete.

## Info

`Terminal.Info: TermInfo`

Read-only instance property.

A fresh read-only snapshot of cached capabilities and current logical `Columns`/`Rows`. Sends no query to the terminal; previously stored `TERMINFO` values remain unchanged.

## Input

`Terminal.Input: TermInput`

Read-only instance property.

Keyboard, mouse, audio-completion and logical-resize events for the caller. Mouse and physical-key reporting require activation; `EventKind.Resize` does not. Call `Release` to return input to the board.

## LoadFont

```PPL
Terminal.LoadFont(INTEGER font, STRING file) BOOLEAN
```

Instance function.

Loads a board-relative font file, decodes it with `BitFont`, and uploads it into writable terminal font number 43–255. File, format and per-session upload limits are reported through `Error.Last()`.
<br><br>**Terminal protocol:** sends the CTerm DCS `DCS CTerm:Font:font:base64 ST`, bytes `ESC P CTerm:Font:… ESC \`. The payload is a base64-encoded 256-glyph bitmap. This is a CTerm extension, not standard ANSI.

## Macros

`Terminal.Macros: Macros`

Read-only instance property.

Records and replays the raw byte stream sent to this caller. Slots are local to the session.

## Margins

`Terminal.Margins: Margins`

Read-only instance property.

The terminal's active scrolling and text-output margins.

## Palette

`Terminal.Palette: Palette`

Read-only instance property.

Controls the 16 DOS palette entries through xterm-compatible OSC 4 and OSC 104 commands.

## SetFont

```PPL
Terminal.SetFont(INTEGER font, [INTEGER slot]) BOOLEAN
```

Instance function.

Selects font number 0–255 for attribute slot 0–3. If `slot` is omitted, the font is assigned to all four slots; `LoadFont` can upload writable font numbers 43–255.
<br><br>**Terminal protocol:** sends the SyncTERM/CTerm extension `CSI slot ; font SP D`, bytes `ESC [ slot ; font SPACE D`, once per selected attribute slot. This is not standard ANSI.
